description: This file defines the ContentTypeQueryResourceBuilder class, which constructs GraphQL query strings with support for nested fields and arguments.

classes.name: ContentTypeQueryResourceBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing GraphQL query strings with nested fields and arguments.

methods.name: ContentTypeQueryResourceBuilder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the builder with a content type.

methods.name: WithField
methods.description: Adds a field to the query.

methods.name: WithNestedField
methods.description: Adds a nested field, returning a new builder for that nested context.

methods.name: WithQueryStringArgument
methods.description: Adds a top-level query argument with a string value.

methods.name: WithQueryArgument (overload)
methods.description: Adds a query argument with a field name and value.

methods.name: WithQueryStringArgument (overload)
methods.description: Adds a query argument with a field name and string value.

methods.name: WithNestedQueryArgument
methods.description: Adds a nested query argument with a field value.

methods.name: Build
methods.description: Constructs and returns the final GraphQL query string.
